rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule targets article-draft prose; this file is a lecture memo, not an article draft.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
Over-hedge detector.
Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule governs how the generation-time reference artefact captures a verbal frame, not the shipped lecture body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 27: "Geoff Charles" then "Charles's actual line" — two mentions but contiguous anaphora within one paragraph telling a single fact, not credit-collecting across separate placements.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No punchy reframe that overstates for a subset of cases found in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body (lines 1-66): 21 uses of "Claude" vs 1 use of "the agent" vs 8 uses of "LLM". Multiple "Claude" uses describe autonomous multi-step action per the rule's own acting-vs-thinking split (e.g. line 17 "Claude opened the session with a plan", line 19 "Claude used it twice in the third turn", line 29 "Claude had conflated them and written the conflation into a reference page") which the rule's default maps to "the agent", not "Claude". Matches the rule's stated audit signal example almost exactly (10:0 flagged; here 21:1).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Recast the acting-description instances (opened the session, used the banned word, wrote/conflated content) to "the agent"; keep "Claude" for addressee/version-grounding uses (e.g. `claude-opus-4-7`, "I asked Claude").
